executive_pulse: CISA added four new KEV entries covering SAP NetWeaver, VMware vCenter, Cisco Expressway and Apache Roller. All require immediate remediation per vendor guidance.

items.headline: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements (CVE-2025-42884)
items.summary: Unauthenticated attacker can disclose or modify server information via improper input handling in SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal.
items.action: Apply SAP security bulletin patches and follow CISA BOD 26-04 mitigation guidance.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event

items.headline: VMware vCenter Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-123890)
items.summary: Unauthenticated network‑connected attacker can bypass authentication via an alternate path in VMware Directory Service.
items.action: Apply Broadcom security advisory patches and enforce network segmentation per CISA BOD 26-04.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event

items.headline: Cisco Expressway Series Hard‑coded Credentials (CVE-2026-76466)
items.summary: Hard‑coded credentials enable unauthenticated remote attackers with persistent cookies to execute commands as root.
items.action: Update to Cisco‑released fix and apply recommended mitigations per CISA BOD 26-04.

compensating_controls: Restrict the device's management interface to an admin network; check for new admin accounts and config changes
Restrict network access to the affected service to known management hosts
Change any credentials the vendor allows you to change and monitor for logins by built-in accounts
remediation.verify: Search authentication logs for logins by built-in or service accounts from unexpected sources

items.headline: Apache Roller XML‑RPC Deserialization (CVE-2026-129448)
items.summary: Unauthenticated remote attacker can achieve arbitrary code execution via crafted XML‑RPC payloads.
items.action: Apply Apache security update and restrict XML‑RPC access per CISA BOD 26-04.

compensating_controls: Restrict the device's management interface to an admin network; check for new admin accounts and config changes
Block or filter untrusted network access to the affected endpoint (WAF rule or network ACL)
Run the service with least privilege and no outbound internet access where possible
remediation.verify: Hunt for unexpected child processes spawned by the application server process

items.headline: ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections – AI agent attack detection repo
items.target: Detection rules & KQL hunts for AI agent frameworks
items.summary: Repo provides KQL detection queries and IOCs for AI‑agent attack frameworks such as ARTEX, PentAGI, HexStrike, and others.
items.action: Review repository content, validate KQL queries against your Splunk environment, and integrate relevant detections.
